pairs.evidence: src/api/__tests__/lensScan.test.ts:21 The test is named for a camelCase-args guard, but listLensScanProducts (src/api/lensScan.ts:83) takes no arguments and the test only checks the command name. The args that startLensScan, getLensScanCommitDiff and getLensScanShot send are asserted nowhere. A grep for the guard stops at a name that guards nothing, and a snake_case key on those three wrappers would stay green.

techniques.evidence: src/api/__tests__/lensScan.test.ts:21 The test name claims a stronger guard than its assertions make. The technique says to rename it and pin the args at the crossing. The earlier enums.test.ts deviation is resolved: :52 now reads VALID_CHANNELS from twin.rs.

src/api/__tests__/desktopCapabilityRisk.test.ts:33 The parity pins strip comments, use call-shaped needles and fail loudly on an unmatched end needle instead of slicing to EOF. .gitattributes pins *.rs to eol=lf, so the \n}\n needles hold.
src/api/__tests__/localDayOffsetParity.test.ts:65 The CASES population is derived by walking the Rust commands, and the walk has a floor: zero commands found is a failure, not a pass.
src/api/__tests__/webbuildTimeoutParity.test.ts:66 The claim that the wrapper outlives the backend cutoff is asserted from the declared budgets read out of the Rust source, never from wall time.
src/api/__tests__/credentials.test.ts:26 These are unit tests on the in-memory fixture tier: a name-routed invoke stub, reset before every test.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/analytics/index.ts:79 Tab tracking reads each dimension's store field by a string key cast through unknown. No test drives a tab dimension through a store: session.test.ts:29 stubs a state carrying only sidebarSection, and summary.test.ts checks only that keys are unique. A renamed store field would make readTab return undefined, and that tab would silently report as never visited. All 14 keys match real store fields today, so the gap is latent.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/analytics/session.test.ts:29 The stub makes the tab-dimension decision unreachable and does not say so. The string-keyed crossing is untyped, so the technique's exemption for a typed crossing does not apply. The sink decision itself is reached (sink.test.ts:32 drives the real trackInteraction).
src/lib/analytics/sink.test.ts:12 The module-global sink is restored after every test, so test order cannot leak it.
src/lib/analytics/summary.test.ts:40 The denominator is derived from the catalog and has a floor, so an empty derivation fails.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/mcp_server/auth_tests.rs:24 The auth-gate tests hand-write the external_api_keys and api_key_audit schema instead of using the migrated template. The table now exists in four places (initial.rs:350 plus the c03 ALTERs, external_api_keys.rs:405, broker_edges.rs:219, here), so a migration change leaves these tests passing against yesterday's schema. Each test's temp DB also uses the prefix mcp_auth_test_, which neither the crate sweep (TEST_DB_PREFIXES) nor scripts/build/run-rust-tests.mjs:319-324 reclaims, so every run leaks the files.
